dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible with sharp luminance transitions from a dark exterior to a light interior. dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of small, solid high-intensity pixel clusters without internal gradients, primarily concentrated in the anterior neck region and along the lower lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle in the center-left quadrant of the visible torso. A secondary linear alignment is formed by four smaller circular clusters along the upper dorsal ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: A continuous, undulating high-contrast line of light pixels runs longitudinally along the ventral-lateral boundary, terminating near the posterior flipper.
